text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"shelves","kind":"count","span":"each of the middle 2 shelves"},{"id":"q2","value":10,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"can hold 10 books"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"twice as many books as a middle shelf"},{"id":"q4","value":5,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"5 fewer books than the bottom shelf"},{"id":"q5","value":110,"unit":"books","kind":"count","span":"she has 110 books"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"number of middle shelves times books per middle shelf gives total middle-shelf capacity"},{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"books per middle shelf times 2 (twice as many) gives bottom shelf capacity"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"bottom shelf capacity minus 5 gives top shelf capacity"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"middle shelves capacity plus bottom shelf capacity"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"plus top shelf capacity gives total capacity of one bookcase"},{"op":"div","args":["q5","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"total books divided by one bookcase's capacity gives the number of bookcases needed"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"number of bookcases Elly needs to hold all 110 books"},"dismissed":[]}
